checks.name: Product buckets and operator groups account for every registry record exactly once
Production counts each complex once and keeps coverage explicit
Different reporting periods are never silently combined
Missing production and empty filters remain missing rather than zero output
Operator, product, region and query filters intersect without losing unverified operators
Destination filtering uses actual recorded relationships and distinct mine counts
Shortlists discard malformed, stale and duplicate IDs and are capped at four
Revenue units and FX direction agree with hand-calculated amounts
Zero volume and zero price are valid while malformed scenarios fail
Comparison preserves complex basis, periods, missing values and primary source links
CSV quotes separators and neutralizes formula prefixes including leading whitespace
Every production profile has a finite nonnegative value and resolvable source
